text:
Maria Chen: Quick idea — run a 48hr "Recognition Sprint" next week to surface micro-spot awards before the all-hands. Short window, lightweight noms, fast approvals. Thoughts? :tada:
Anita Patel: love it. lean + fast. what's our budget per award? and who signs off?
Jess Rivera: recommend $100 e-gift or 2 extra office credits. Approvals could be a 3-person rotating panel. keep it < 24hr turnaround.
Kai Nakamura: +1 on rotating panel. can we auto-filter duplicates? hate seeing 3 noms for same thing.
Tyler O'Neill: logistics q — do we use the existing nomination form or a quick Google form? also need an expense code.
Maria Chen: use a quick form so entries are small (name, reason, 1 sentence). I'll spin up the form. expense code: REC-Q2-2026. Jess can you confirm gift vendors?
Jess Rivera: I'll confirm vendor list by EOD. Options: Amazon e-gift, local coffee shop e-vouchers, and a Redwood swag bundle (small). We should let nominator pick preference.
Anita Patel: approval flow idea: People Ops Bot posts new noms to this thread channel with a short ID. Panel votes "approve" in thread. if 2/3 approve, ops issues award. keeps audit trail.
People Ops Bot: (automated) I can post new nominations -> format: "NOM #123 — nominee: X — reason: Y". Use `/approve NOM #123` or reply with "approve". I will track votes and post final status.
Kai Nakamura: can People Ops Bot also check nominee tenure/previous-awards? to avoid repeat winners in same quarter.
Maria Chen: yes, add a quick de-dupe check. if conflict detected, flag to panel instead of auto-approve.
Tyler O'Neill: timeline: Form open Tue 9am -> Thu 9am. Panel review Thurs 9–11am, payouts Thu afternoon. Announce winners in Fri all-hands. Is that aggressive?
Anita Patel: fits. Block calendar invites for panel. I'll rotate panel: Maria / Jess / Kai for this sprint, Tyler backfill if someone is OOO.
Jess Rivera: added task: prepare short thank-you blurb for all winners (1 sentence) so comms team can include it.
Maria Chen: I'll draft the nomination form now: link -> https://forms.gle/rec-sprint-q2 (placeholder). Please test with 1 sample nom by EOD.
People Ops Bot: (automated) Sample nom posted: "NOM #001 — nominee: Tyler O'Neill — reason: took lead on infra rollback, kept product live". Panel: reply "approve" or "flag".
Kai Nakamura: approve
Jess Rivera: approve :thumbsup:
Anita Patel: approve — looks good.
Maria Chen: perfect — once Jess confirms vendor list we'll finalize payouts. thanks team! :sparkles:
